U.S. Census Bureau geometry — public domain

Source geometry: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic state boundaries, 2017 edition,
redistributed as TopoJSON by us-atlas@3.0.1.
Census source file used by us-atlas:
https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/GENZ2017/shp/cb_2017_us_state_5m.zip

Census Bureau public-domain statement, quoted verbatim from:
2025 TIGER/Line Shapefiles Technical Documentation, Issued September 2025,
Section 1.2 "Citation Information"
https://www2.census.gov/geo/pdfs/maps-data/data/tiger/tgrshp2025/TGRSHP2025_TechDoc.pdf

  "Copyright protection is not available for any work of the United States
  Government (Title 17 U.S.C., Section 105). Thus, you are free to reproduce
  census materials as you see fit. We would ask, however, that you cite the
  Census Bureau as the source."

Suggested citation:
  U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Cartographic Boundary Files (cb_2017_us_state_5m),
  accessed via us-atlas@3.0.1.

The same technical documentation, Section 1.1, notes that TIGER/Line is a
registered trademark of the Census Bureau and cannot be used in a proprietary
product name; this project does not use that name as a product name. It also
states that boundaries are for statistical purposes and are not legal land
descriptions.
